Implemented the reservation fixes:

- Duplicate SKUs now combine quantities, and receipt items are sorted deterministically.
- Request identities are scoped to both tenant and request ID.
- Stock updates are staged on a clone and only published after all items pass validation.
- Stock reads and consumption respect own tenant/SKU properties, avoiding inherited object properties.

Verification: `node --test tests/visible.test.mjs` passed. Additional contract checks for retries, tenant isolation, snapshots, conflicts, and atomic failure also passed.
